defs.d: A person employed to perform computations; one who computes.
(by restriction) A male computer, where the female computer is called a computress.
An uncertainty, possibility, condition, doubt etc.
Supposing that, assuming that, in the circumstances that; used to introduce a condition or choice.
defs.ex: If it rains, I shall get wet.

defs.d: In the event that a statement is true (a programming statement that acts in a similar manner).
defs.ex: If A, then B, else C.

defs.d: An instance of listening.
defs.ex: Give the motor a listen and tell me if it sounds off.

defs.d: To pay attention to a sound or speech.
defs.ex: Please listen carefully as I explain.  I like to listen to music.

defs.d: To expect or wait for a sound, such as a signal.
defs.ex: You should listen for the starting gun.

defs.d: Preparation
To make ready for a specific future purpose; to set up; to assemble or equip.
defs.ex: We prepared the spacecraft for takeoff.

defs.d: To make ready for eating or drinking; to cook.
defs.ex: We prepared a fish for dinner.

defs.d: A judgment, sentence, or final decision. Specifically: The decision of arbitrators in a case submitted.
The paper containing the decision of arbitrators; that which is warded.
To give by sentence or judicial determination; to assign or apportion, after careful regard to the nature of the case; to adjudge
defs.ex: the arbitrators awarded damages to the complainant

defs.d: To determine; to make or grant an award.
Most of the time; less than always, but more than occasionally.
defs.ex: Except for one or two days a year, he usually walks to work.

defs.d: Under normal conditions.
Any plant.
A plant raised for some edible part of it, such as the leaves, roots, fruit or flowers, but excluding any plant considered to be a fruit, grain, herb, or spice in the culinary sense.
Of or relating to plants.
Of or relating to vegetables.
(usually plural) A container, especially a bottle, whose contents have been used up, leaving it empty.
defs.ex: Put the empties out to be recycled.

defs.d: To make empty; to void; to remove the contents of.
defs.ex: The cinema emptied quickly after the end of the film.

defs.d: Of a river, duct, etc: to drain or flow toward an ultimate destination.
defs.ex: Salmon River empties on the W shore about 2 miles below Bear River.

defs.d: Devoid of content; containing nothing or nobody; vacant.
defs.ex: an empty purse; an empty jug; an empty stomach

defs.d: Containing no elements (as of a string, array, or set), opposed to being null (having no valid value).
A person or animal with curly hair.
Having curls.
Curling in a direction, as opposed to straight (quotation marks or apostrophes)
To ask for the presence or participation of someone or something.
defs.ex: We invited our friends round for dinner.

defs.d: To request formally.
defs.ex: I invite you all to be seated.

defs.d: A distinct physical object.
defs.ex: Tweezers are great for manipulating small items.

defs.d: (by extension) An object that can be picked up for later use.
To make a note of.
Likewise
A centre, midpoint.
defs.ex: The middle of a circle is the point which has the same distance to every point of circle.

defs.d: The part between the beginning and the end.
defs.ex: I woke up in the middle of the night.

defs.d: To take a middle view of.
To double (a rope) into two equal portions; to fold in the middle.
Located in the middle; in between.
defs.ex: the middle point

defs.d: Central.
The natural world; that which consists of all things unaffected by or predating human technology, production, and design. (Compare ecosystem.)
defs.ex: Nature never lies (i.e. tells untruths).

defs.d: The innate characteristics of a thing. What something will tend by its own constitution, to be or do. Distinct from what might be expected or intended.
To endow with natural qualities.
An answer or reply, or something in the nature of an answer or reply.
The act of responding or replying; reply: as, to speak in response to a question.
The act of appointing a person to hold an office or to have a position of trust
defs.ex: His appointment was deemed suitable

defs.d: The state of being appointed to a service or office; an office to which one is appointed
defs.ex: the appointment of treasurer

defs.d: An aircraft that is borne along by one or more sets of long rotating blades which allow it to hover, move in any direction including reverse, or land; and typically having a smaller set of blades on its tail that stabilize the aircraft.
defs.ex: We flew over the city in a helicopter.

defs.d: A powered troweling machine with spinning blades used to spread concrete.
To transport by helicopter.
To travel by helicopter.
(manner) In a serious or literal manner.
defs.ex: He was hoping that we would take him seriously.

defs.d: Gravely; deeply; very much.
defs.ex: That was a seriously unpleasant thing to say.

defs.d: A mental or emotional state, composure.
defs.ex: I've been in a bad mood since I dumped my boyfriend.

defs.d: Emotional character (of a work of music, literature, or other art).
Containing sufficient poison to be dangerous to touch or ingest.
Negative, harmful.
That which is silent; a time of silence.
A silent movie
Free from sound or noise; absolutely still; perfectly quiet.
Not speaking; indisposed to talk; speechless; mute; taciturn; not loquacious; not talkative.
Despite that; however.
defs.ex: I will do it, though.

defs.d: (degree) Used to intensify statements or questions; indeed.
defs.ex: "Man, it's hot in here." — "Isn't it, though?"

defs.d: Despite the fact that; although.
defs.ex: Though it’s risky, it’s worth taking the chance.

defs.d: If, that, even if.
defs.ex: We shall be not sorry though the man die tonight.

defs.d: With steadfastness; with resolve; in loyalty, faithfully.
In a constant manner; occurring continuously; persistently.
A period of time before an event occurs; the act of delaying; procrastination; lingering inactivity.
defs.ex: the delay before the echo of a sound

defs.d: An audio effects unit that introduces a controlled delay.
To put off until a later time; to defer.
To retard; to stop, detain, or hinder, for a time.
defs.ex: The mail is delayed by a heavy fall of snow.

defs.d: (usually in the plural) A leading or primary principle, rule, law, or article, which serves as the groundwork of a system; an essential part
defs.ex: one of the fundamentals of linear algebra

defs.d: The lowest frequency of a periodic waveform.
Pertaining to the foundation or basis; serving for the foundation.
Essential, as an element, principle, or law; important; original; elementary.
defs.ex: A need for belonging seems fundamental to humans.

defs.d: To do as ordered by (a person, institution etc), to act according to the bidding of.
To do as one is told.
Of a kind likely to be damaging; injurious
defs.ex: Wear a hat to protect your skin from harmful sunlight.

defs.d: A clause, as in legal documents, stating whereas.
Where (that).
In contrast; whilst on the contrary; although.
defs.ex: He came first in the race, whereas his brother came last.

defs.d: It being the fact that; inasmuch as. (Often used in recitals)
